name: Vivian Carmine
source:
In an average town somewhere in America, a disturbance has been felt. Vivian Carmine and her badge, Nicholas, have come from the Gap Between Worlds to investigate. The game features about 10,000 words and a secret path!

[from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=66681]Lemmasoft[/url]]
translation:
在美国某处的一个普通城镇，已经感受到了骚乱。薇薇安·卡米恩和她的徽章尼古拉斯从世界间隙前来调查。游戏有大约10,000个单词和一条秘密路径！

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=66681]Lemmasoft[/url]]
